passage: Readers who prefer long descriptions may find the author's novels surprising. Her prose is notably ______: she uses short sentences, plain words, and almost no description, leaving readers to imagine the details for themselves.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
steps: Clue: short sentences, plain words, little description.
Writing with very little ornament is "spare."
"Ornate" (elaborately decorated) is the opposite; nothing suggests repetition or technical vocabulary.
key: Match the word to all of the details given, not just one.
